sections.text: KAT6A encodes a histone acetyltransferase and transcriptional coactivator.

sections.text: CREBBP encodes CBP, a transcriptional coactivator and histone acetyltransferase.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 1387 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record

sections.text: The fusion joins KAT6A to an acetyltransferase-associated coactivator. Domain-preserving fusion constructs induced AML in mice and altered chromatin-associated transcription in experimental models.

audit_evidence.location: Results: Development of K/C and K/P murine leukemia models; Figures 1,3,6
audit_evidence.scope: Fusion-construct oncogenicity and chromatin-associated transcription; not validation of all clinical phenotypic claims.

sections.text: Adult AML with KAT6A::CREBBP is assigned adverse ELN 2022 genetic risk.
